desc:
⚔️ DRAGON BALL HYPER REBORN ⚔️

Train, battle, and transform in a progression-based anime fighting RPG. Increase your stats, master melee and Ki combat, defeat powerful bosses, unlock powerful forms, and advance through 110 Zenkai boosts.

⚡ Train to increase your power
🔥 Unlock powerful transformations
🥊 Master melee attacks and Ki blasts
👹 Defeat powerful bosses
👥 Play with friends for a training multiplier
🌎 Available on PC, Mobile, and Console

❤️ Like the experience to support future updates!
🌟 Roblox Plus members receive a Mythic item!

SHUTDOWN = UPDATE
MAX ZENKAI BOOST = 110
MAX PRESTIGE = 16

PC CONTROLS
[Q] Ki Blast
[E] Melee
[R] Training
[B] Transform
[M] Toggle Menu
[V] Toggle Aura
[F] Scouter
Flying: Double-jump

⚠️ Exploiting will result in a permanent ban.
